checks.text: With no input, the page shows the heading "QR Maker", the text "Enter text or a URL to generate a QR code", and the button "Generate" is disabled.
Typing "Hello" in the field labelled "Content" enables the button "Generate"; clicking it shows an SVG element with the aria-label "QR code for Hello" and the text "Error correction: L" below it.

Typing "https://example.com" in the field labelled "Content", choosing "H" in the select labelled "Error correction", and clicking "Generate" shows an SVG element with the aria-label "QR code for https://example.com" and the text "Error correction: H".
Clicking the button "Copy" after generating a QR code for "Hello" shows the tooltip "Copied" for 2 seconds and the button label returns to "Copy".
Clicking the button "Download" after generating a QR code for "Hello" triggers a file download named "qr-hello.svg" containing valid SVG markup.
Typing an empty string in the field labelled "Content" and clicking "Generate" shows the message "Content cannot be empty" and no SVG element is rendered.

Typing "Test" in the field labelled "Content", clicking "Generate", then changing the select labelled "Error correction" to "Q" and clicking "Generate" again shows an SVG element with the aria-label "QR code for Test" and the text "Error correction: Q".
After generating a QR code for "Persist", reloading the page still shows the SVG element with the aria-label "QR code for Persist" and the field labelled "Content" contains "Persist".
